budget.next: App framework and routing; the same major as the old tree (16.1.6), pinned exact.
budget.react: UI runtime required by next; pinned to the old tree's 19.2.3.
budget.react-dom: DOM renderer required by next; pinned to the old tree's 19.2.3.
budget.@supabase/supabase-js: The one database and auth client for the user client and the service client.
budget.@supabase/ssr: Cookie-backed session for the user client in server components and route handlers.
budget.zod: Request and payload validation at every boundary (src/core/http/parse.ts); the old tree had no validator.
budget.eslint-config-next: Next lint rules; bundles the typescript-eslint and import plugins, so no separate plugin is added.
budget.@types/node: Node types for scripts and next.config.ts.
budget.unpdf: PDF text extraction (pdf.js, serverless build) for the direct transport, held-pool reads and the mint capture; the Edge Function loads its own copy via npm: specifier.
budget.zustand: Client state stores (workspace identity, per-item state, dashboard settings) that the shell and every surface read, and the admin source registry filter (features/sources/store.ts); the same major as the old tree.
budget.playwright: headless transport on the Actions runner and the parity gate; never bundled (dynamic import, browser installed only on the runner).
